Core Formula
Three-Tier Taxonomy
- PER-M: Measurement/metric tier tracking baseline loss.
- PER-C: Cultural/compositional tier tracking aggregate provenance shift.
- PER-D: Domain-specific enforcement or discard tier (e.g., extractive processing equivalents where labor or authorial metadata is treated as discarded byproduct, hitting `1.00`).
Key Domains
- AI composition: Loss of source attribution during text/media generation.
- AI-mediated production: Pipeline abstraction where intermediary transformations drop metadata.
- Historical/cultural erasure: Institutional or archival omission of origin context.
